overview: A historical real-time strategy game with a six-resource economy, four ages, ten-player lobbies, teams and diplomacy, and an energy grid that powers advanced weapons.
features: Ten-player lobby with Open, AI, and Closed slots and per-player population limits
Six-resource economy: Food, Wood, Gold, Stone, Money, and Energy
Four ages of advancement with per-age energy generation buildings
Teams 1-6 with allies, shared base access, and shared vision research
Market trading, financial aid, and investment contracts
Automated farms that produce Food every 20 seconds
Energy grid with distribution centers and weapon power throttling
Dense forests, large-scale maps, and smooth group pathfinding
In-game manual with five detailed guide tabs
